# VectorElement

**Class:** `UltraCanvasVectorElement` · **Group:** [Text, images and media](../Groups/Text-images-and-media.md) · **Header:** [`UltraCanvas/include/UltraCanvasVectorElement.h`](../../../UltraCanvas/include/UltraCanvasVectorElement.h) · `#include "UltraCanvasVectorElement.h"`

**Inherits:** [`UltraCanvasUIElement`](UltraCanvasUIElement.md) → `Element`

## What it is for

Show a vector drawing (`VectorStorage::VectorDocument` — SVG, XAR, DXF, DWG (also `.dwt` / `.dws` / `.sv$`), EMF, WMF, AI via the Vector plugin) with zoom / pan

## Creating it

Factory functions (the usual way - every element is held in a `std::shared_ptr`):

```cpp
std::shared_ptr<UltraCanvasVectorElement> CreateVectorElement( const std::string& identifier = "VectorElement", int x = 0, int y = 0, int width = 400, int height = 300);
```

Constructors:

```cpp
UltraCanvasVectorElement(const std::string& identifier = "VectorElement", int x = 0, int y = 0, int width = 400, int height = 300);
```

The first string argument is always the element's **identifier**, never its text (see [Core concepts](../Core-Concepts.md#identifiers)).
